notes: Noise: needs the roof cooling plant in an enclosed plant room. On the roof, even with low-noise chillers and a solid screen, it would give about 73 dBA at 1147 GRANT ST (I-2, activity zone), 31 m away, over the 65 dBA night limit (Noise Control By-law 6555 s. 2.3(b)(ii)). The plant room is the next measure, and the least that passes; its floor comes out of the building (register arch_nz_nswDcNoise).

Generator test (Noise By-law 6555 s. 4.1(c)): one set at a time is about 79.2 dB(A) at 6.1 m (the nearest lot line is 3 m away, closer than 6.1 m, so measured at 6.1 m), within the 80 dB(A) test limit (Kohler enclosure sheet G6-154 for KD2000, Sound Level 2, 78 dB(A) at 7 m, maker claim; free field, our arithmetic). Sets tested together would be louder. Running in a power cut as emergency works (s. 4.3(c)): our reading (?).
Lot lines: which yard one of this lot's edges has is not known (?); the deepest it could have is applied (see Lot lines).

Noise: needs a plant room: solid walls, roof RW 47 or better, gaps sealed, louvres of at least 6–27 dB by band (NSW 2021 Table 4-5): −25 dB (arch_nz_nswDcNoise). Without it: about 78–81 dBA (quieter–standard unit rating) at the point of reception beside 1471 CLARK DR (I-2, activity zone) (no building on record: point of reception at its lot line, our reading), 23 m away; limit 65 dBA at night (Noise Control By-law 6555 s. 2.3(b)(ii)).

loadingNeed.basis: 4 truck loading bays: 4 for the data centre's 6,900 m² of floor. Each class of use is counted separately and the counts added (Parking By-law s. 5.1, Multi-Use Developments). The by-law calls this size Class B, its mid-size bay: 10.2 × 3.4 m with 3.8 m clearance (Class C is the 23.1 m bay for the largest trucks). The data centre uses row 5.2.5: the by-law does not name data centres, but the City classes them as a Transportation and Storage use (RTS 19744), which row 5.2.5 lists. Each bay is reached by a 6.1 m aisle (s. 5.4.1). If the City reads a data centre as a storage warehouse, 2 Class C s…

genLines: 7 generator sets of about 2 MW carry 14.0 MW; with spares, 8. Placed: 0 on the roof, 8 in the yard.
Each about 13.493 × 3.488 m, 4.777 m high; 1.5 m from the building, 2 m between sets (1 m clear all round, CSA C282 6.5.1.1; register arch_csa_c282).

Fuel in each set's sub-base tank: about 6300 L. In the yard: 3 m from the property line and 1.5 m from the building (CSA B139.1.0 Table 2; register arch_csa_b139). On a roof: at most 1,250 L a tank and 2,500 L a supply line (B139.1.1 6.5.3). FM 5-32 (insurer guidance, not law): not on the roof or in a basement.

base.rule: Building height is measured from the base surface: the surface joining the official established building grades at all corners of the site, from the City Engineer; existing grades only where those cannot be obtained or the Director of Planning finds them incompatible (Zoning and Development By-law s. 2, 'Base Surface' p. 4, 'Building Height' p. 5). noiseRoom.block: Noise: the cooling plant (roof) would give about 73 dBA (low-noise units: one rating) at the point of reception beside 1147 GRANT ST (I-2, activity zone), 31 m away, even with low-noise chillers (Trane RTAF 280 LN, maker claim) + a 4.9 m solid screen (roof; NSW 2021, −8 dB): over the 65 dBA night limit with the quieter rating (Noise Control By-law 6555 s. 2.3(b)(ii); the plant runs 24 h, so the night limit governs). 24 neighbouring lots are over. No modelled option brings it under. To bring it under: a smaller size (fewer units); the cooling plant in the yard or split, if that moves it further…
